item.title: CBI chief rejects claims of Iranian economic collapse at IMF meeting
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Central Bank of Iran Governor Abdolnaser Hemmati has dismissed claims that Iran’s economy is on the verge of collapse, saying it has shown considerable resilience despite the war waged by the United States and the Israeli regime as well as Washington’s maximum sanctions and economic pressure.

item.title: In photos: Iran honors Red Crescent’s first responders
item.description: Tehran held a ceremony on October 13, 2026, to honor members of the Iranian Red Crescent Society (IRCS) for their rescue and relief efforts during the US–Israeli-imposed war on Iran. The event was attended by IRCS President Pirhossein Kolivand, along with senior officials and members of the society.

item.title: Iranian Navy identifies oil tanker that caught fire in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The Iranian Navy says it has identified a non-compliant oil tanker that sustained damage and caught fire in the eastern Strait of Hormuz after switching off its tracking systems and attempting to cross a prohibited area.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86291981/Iranian-Navy-identifies-oil-tanker-that-caught-fire-in-Strait

Tehran, IRNA – The Iranian Navy says it has identified a non-compliant oil tanker that sustained damage and caught fire in the eastern Strait of Hormuz after switching off its tracking systems and attempting to cross a prohibited area.
